note: Practice notes for tuning angles.v2, question.v2 and whynote.v2 (D-027). Unscored. Written 14 Nov 2026, after Run 3; not derived from the 17 scored notes. Everything is invented; any match with a real person, company or product is coincidental. Use these and dev-examples d1-d3 for practice runs. Never tune on eval/set-v1/notes.json.

notes.title: Workshop booking
notes.text: Booking page for pottery workshops. I've decided to take payment upfront through the card provider I already use for the shop. I don't know if I'm allowed to keep a deposit when someone cancels the day before. I expect most people to book from their phones in the evening. Margit at Clayhouse Studio wants the first version before the spring term.
covers: open-question with a public answer (cancellation and deposit rules)
firm decision (upfront payment through the existing provider)

notes.title: Data on a small server
notes.text: I've decided to keep everything in SQLite on the same small server as the app, because it's simple and I know it well. I assume nightly copies of the file are enough as a backup. Two people will edit records at the same time during busy afternoons. If this works for Harbourline Logistics, they might roll it out to three depots.
covers: firm decision that must not get 'alternatives' (SQLite)
assumption with a checkable fact (copying a live SQLite file as a backup)
limit of the chosen option (concurrent writes)

notes.title: Weekends only
notes.text: I can only work on this at weekends. The client expects a weekly update with something they can click. I'll use a hosted preview link for each update. I haven't decided how to handle feedback that arrives midweek. Budget is €80 a month for all tools.
covers: constraint framing must stay a constraint
open question that only the builder can answer (midweek feedback): checkable false is correct here
money amount must stay out of the question

notes.title: Meeting summaries
notes.text: Users paste meeting notes and get a summary. I'm using a large-model API's free tier for now and assume its limits are fine for twenty users. I don't know whether I can store the pasted notes for a month to improve the summaries. Some notes will be in German and Polish.
covers: assumption with a checkable fact (free-tier limits)
open question with a public answer (storing user content, data protection)
